rule_1.name: Customer notification: first foreign cash withdrawal of business day
conditions: Current event's country differs from home_country
No earlier foreign transaction for this user on the same business day
Current status is APPROVED or DECLINED

rule_2.name: Foreign cash withdrawal with a different-country transaction within 90 minutes
conditions: One event is a cash withdrawal in a country different from that user's home_country
Another event for the same user is in a country different from the cash-withdrawal country
The absolute time difference between the two events is >= 0 and < 90 minutes
Either event may occur first; the alert record references the qualifying cash withdrawal
The other-country event does not have to be a cash withdrawal and can be domestic or foreign relative to home_country

rule_3.name: High velocity or cumulative amount of foreign cash withdrawals
rule_3.count_scope: foreign cash-withdrawal events for the same user on the same business day
rule_3.amount_scope: sum of amount_idr_equiv for foreign cash-withdrawal events for the same user on the same business day, including the current event
rule_3.amount_threshold_alert_frequency: at most once per user per business day, on the first foreign cash withdrawal that brings the running sum to or above the threshold
conditions: Current event's country differs from home_country
Current transaction number is exactly 5 OR daily cumulative amount reaches/exceeds Rp6,000,000 equivalent
rule_3.count_comparison: first time count reaches or exceeds 5; at most one count alert per user per business day
